cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(opom_compiler LANGUAGES C CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(LUAU_BUILD_CLI OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(LUAU_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
if(OPOM_LUAU_SOURCE)
    add_subdirectory("${OPOM_LUAU_SOURCE}" luau)
else()
    include(FetchContent)
    FetchContent_Declare(luau
        GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/luau-lang/luau.git
        GIT_TAG 12a6ba75883272c79b66b59815efef4c574196f6)
    FetchContent_MakeAvailable(luau)
endif()
add_executable(opom-compiler native/compiler.cpp)
target_link_libraries(opom-compiler PRIVATE Luau.Compiler)
